about: The latest videos on YouTube for the site's four video buttons, one for each view: usd, the bars in dollars (HISTORY (USD VALUE)), btc, in coins (HISTORY (BTC)), pctusd, every bar as its percent of the day's realized cap (HISTORY (% USD VALUE)), and pctbtc, of the day's supply (HISTORY (% BTC)). Written by .github/workflows/video.yml once an upload is viewable (unlisted or public); null until then.
